shortDescription: Manages trusted-client objects on Checkpoint over Web Services API

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: domains_assignment
options.description: Domains to be added to this profile. Use domain name only. See example below, "add-trusted-client (with domain)".

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address. If both addresses are required use ipv4-address and ipv6-address fields explicitly.

options.name: ip_address_first
options.description: First IP address in the range. If both IPv4 and IPv6 address ranges are required, use the ipv4-address-first and the ipv6-address-first fields instead.

options.name: ip_address_last
options.description: Last IP address in the range. If both IPv4 and IPv6 address ranges are required, use the ipv4-address-first and the ipv6-address-first fields instead.

options.name: ipv4_address
options.description: IPv4 address.

options.name: ipv4_address_first
options.description: First IPv4 address in the range.

options.name: ipv4_address_last
options.description: Last IPv4 address in the range.

options.name: ipv6_address
options.description: IPv6 address.

options.name: ipv6_address_first
options.description: First IPv6 address in the range.

options.name: ipv6_address_last
options.description: Last IPv6 address in the range.

options.name: mask_length
options.description: IPv4 or IPv6 mask length. If both masks are required use mask-length4 and mask-length6 fields explicitly.

options.name: mask_length4
options.description: IPv4 mask length.

options.name: mask_length6
options.description: IPv6 mask length.

options.name: multi_domain_server_trusted_client
options.description: Let this trusted client connect to all Multi-Domain Servers in the deployment.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers.

options.name: type
options.description: Trusted client type.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.

options.name: wild_card
options.description: IP wild card (e.g. 192.0.2.*).
